Early Revolutionary CuNi — bodega / bus / mercado change the year of the Missile Crisis, three years after Batista fell. C252.story: A 1962 20 centavos from Cuba. The reverse shows a portrait of José Martí with the date; arms side REPUBLICA DE CUBA, Escudo (key, stripes, palm), oak and laurel, Phrygian-cap star, VEINTE CENTAVOS. Struck in cupronickel.
